reason: Wendy's operates and franchises quick-service hamburger restaurants, selling prepared food to consumers at drive-thrus, in restaurants and by delivery. Simply Good Foods owns packaged protein and low-carb snack brands, such as Quest, and sells them through grocery, club and mass retailers and online. The products differ: prepared restaurant meals against shelf-stable packaged snacks. The routes to market differ: restaurants and franchisees against retail distribution. The business models differ: franchise royalties and restaurant sales against branded product sales made by contract manufacturers. The only link is that both sell food to consumers.
